Private Function Note(e As Long, v As Variant) As String
    If e <> 0 Then
        Note = "e" & e
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
        Note = TypeName(v)
    ElseIf IsError(v) Then
        Note = CStr(v)
    Else
        Note = TypeName(v) & " " & CStr(v)
    End If
End Function
